# 香港十八區日系足跡熱力圖 (Hong Kong 18 Districts Footprint Heatmap)
這是本專案的完整源始碼與架構，請以此為基礎協助進行功能擴充、修改或重構。

---

## 專案介紹
這是一個基於 React 19 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS 的香港十八區足跡熱力圖互動網頁應用。
地圖採用高精確度 SVG 向量路徑（包含全港 18 個行政區的所有海岸線、散落島嶼及每條 path 的 translate 偏移量）。
支援點擊記錄足跡次數、Hover 顯示區域名稱及已到訪次數 Tooltip、日系粉色層級熱力圖填色與即時統計。

---

## 目錄結構
- `package.json`: 專案依賴與腳本
- `src/index.css`: Tailwind CSS 引入
- `src/components/HKMapData.ts`: 香港 18 區所有向量路徑與精確座標 (viewBox: 0 0 1385 1013)
- `src/components/HKMap.tsx`: SVG 地圖互動元件
- `src/App.tsx`: 主程式頁面與熱力圖狀態管理

---

## 檔案 4: src/components/HKMap.tsx (SVG 地圖元件)
```tsx
import React from 'react';
import { districtsData } from './HKMapData';

interface HKMapProps {
  counts: Record<string, number>;
  onDistrictClick: (id: string) => void;
  onDistrictHover: (name: string, count: number, e: React.MouseEvent) => void;
  onDistrictLeave: () => void;
}

// 根據次數計算填色
function getFillColor(count: number) {
  if (count <= 0) return 'transparent';
  if (count <= 2) return '#ffe5d9';
  if (count <= 5) return '#ffb5a7';
  if (count <= 9) return '#f8ad9d';
  if (count <= 14) return '#f4978e';
  return '#f07167';
}

export function HKMap({ counts, onDistrictClick, onDistrictHover, onDistrictLeave }: HKMapProps) {
  return (
    <svg 
      id="hk-map" 
      xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" 
      viewBox="0 0 1385 1013" 
      className="w-full h-auto drop-shadow-sm"
    >
      {/* 移除整體 transform，改為個別 path 的 transform */}
      <g id="districts">
        {districtsData.map((district) => {
          const count = counts[district.id] || 0;
          const fillColor = getFillColor(count);
          
          return (
            <g 
              key={district.id}
              id={district.id}
              className="group cursor-pointer transition-all duration-250 ease-out hover:brightness-95"
              onClick={() => onDistrictClick(district.id)}
              onMouseMove={(e) => onDistrictHover(district.name, count, e)}
              onMouseLeave={onDistrictLeave}
            >
              {district.paths.map((path, index) => (
                <path
                  key={`${district.id}-${index}`}
                  d={path.d}
                  transform={path.transform}
                  fill={fillColor}
                  stroke="#B5B5B6"
                  strokeWidth="0.75"
                  strokeLinejoin="round"
                  className="group-hover:stroke-[#2c3e50] group-hover:stroke-[2px]"
                />
              ))}
            </g>
          );
        })}
      </g>
    </svg>
  );
}
```

## 檔案 5: src/App.tsx (主程式)
```tsx
import React, { useState, useCallback, useRef } from 'react';
import { HKMap } from './components/HKMap';
import { MapPin, RotateCcw } from 'lucide-react';

export default function App() {
  const [counts, setCounts] = useState<Record<string, number>>({});
  const [tooltip, setTooltip] = useState({ show: false, name: '', count: 0, x: 0, y: 0 });
  
  // 用於計算 tooltip 相對位置的容器 ref
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const handleDistrictClick = useCallback((id: string) => {
    setCounts(prev => {
      const newCount = (prev[id] || 0) + 1;
      if (tooltip.show) {
        setTooltip(t => ({ ...t, count: newCount }));
      }
      return {
        ...prev,
        [id]: newCount
      };
    });
  }, [tooltip.show]);

  const handleDistrictHover = useCallback((name: string, count: number, e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    if (!containerRef.current) return;
    const rect = containerRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x = e.clientX - rect.left + 15;
    const y = e.clientY - rect.top + 15;

    setTooltip({
      show: true,
      name,
      count,
      x,
      y
    });
  }, []);

  const handleDistrictLeave = useCallback(() => {
    setTooltip(prev => ({ ...prev, show: false }));
  }, []);

  const handleReset = () => {
    if (window.confirm('確定要清空所有足跡紀錄嗎？')) {
      setCounts({});
    }
  };

  const totalVisits = (Object.values(counts) as number[]).reduce((acc, curr) => acc + curr, 0);
  const visitedDistricts = (Object.values(counts) as number[]).filter(c => c > 0).length;

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#f4f6f8] flex flex-col items-center py-12 px-4 font-sans text-slate-800">
      
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="max-w-4xl w-full flex flex-col md:flex-row items-center justify-between mb-8 gap-4">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="bg-red-400 p-2.5 rounded-xl text-white shadow-sm">
            <MapPin size={28} />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-2xl md:text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900">香港十八區日系足跡熱力圖</h1>
            <p className="text-slate-500 font-medium mt-1">點擊地圖記錄你的美食與探險軌跡</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4 bg-white px-5 py-3 rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-slate-100">
          <div className="flex flex-col">
            <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider">總到訪次數</span>
            <span className="text-xl font-bold text-slate-700">{totalVisits}</span>
          </div>
          <div className="w-px h-8 bg-slate-200"></div>
          <div className="flex flex-col">
            <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider">解鎖區域</span>
            <span className="text-xl font-bold text-slate-700">{visitedDistricts} <span className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-400">/ 18</span></span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Map Container */}
      <div 
        ref={containerRef}
        className="w-full max-w-4xl bg-white rounded-3xl shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)] border border-slate-100 p-6 md:p-10 relative overflow-hidden"
      >
        {/* Tooltip */}
        {tooltip.show && (
          <div 
            className="absolute z-10 px-3 py-2 bg-slate-800/95 backdrop-blur-sm text-white text-sm rounded-lg pointer-events-none shadow-lg transform transition-transform duration-75"
            style={{ left: tooltip.x, top: tooltip.y }}
          >
            <strong className="block text-base mb-0.5">{tooltip.name}</strong>
            <span className="text-slate-300">已到訪：<span className="text-white font-bold">{tooltip.count}</span> 間</span>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Legend & Controls overlay */}
        <div className="absolute bottom-6 right-6 flex flex-col gap-3 z-10 pointer-events-none">
          {/* Legend */}
          <div className="bg-white/90 backdrop-blur pointer-events-auto p-4 rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-slate-100">
            <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-widest mb-3">熱力圖層級</h3>
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
              {[
                { color: '#ffe5d9', label: '1-2 間' },
                { color: '#ffb5a7', label: '3-5 間' },
                { color: '#f8ad9d', label: '6-9 間' },
                { color: '#f4978e', label: '10-14 間' },
                { color: '#f07167', label: '15+ 間' },
              ].map(level => (
                <div key={level.label} className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <div className="w-4 h-4 rounded-full shadow-inner" style={{ backgroundColor: level.color }}></div>
                  <span className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-600">{level.label}</span>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
          
          {/* Reset Button */}
          <button 
            onClick={handleReset}
            disabled={totalVisits === 0}
            className="pointer-events-auto flex items-center justify-center gap-2 bg-white text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-slate-200 transition-colors disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed cursor-pointer"
          >
            <RotateCcw size={16} />
            <span className="text-sm font-semibold">重設地圖</span>
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* The SVG Map */}
        <HKMap 
          counts={counts}
          onDistrictClick={handleDistrictClick}
          onDistrictHover={handleDistrictHover}
          onDistrictLeave={handleDistrictLeave}
        />
      </div>

    </div>
  );
}
```

## 運行與部署指引
1. 安裝套件：`npm install`
2. 本地開發：`npm run dev`
3. 也可以直接將上述 `HKMapData.ts` 與 `HKMap.tsx` 複製到任何 Next.js、Vite 或 React 專案中直接使用！
